title: MCP client lists the prompts and follows the server instructions
steps: Connect Claude Code, Cursor and one other client to the control plane's /mcp address and sign in at the tier under test.
Open each client's prompt list.
Start connect_app for a real database, then new_database with the engine left out.
expect: The four prompts appear at the change tier and two at the read tier. connect_app gives host, port and username and never a password. new_database asks for the engine.

title: Plugin installs and offers PDS once
steps: Install the pds plugin from the marketplace in Claude Code, then in Cursor.
In an empty project, ask the agent to build a small app that needs a database and name no database.
Answer the offer with no, then keep working on the app for a few turns.
Repeat in a fresh project, answer yes.
expect: One question offering PDS on the first ask, none after a no, and the PDS tools only after a yes.

title: Create and connect through the plugin and the data server
costs: changes data: creates a database on a real environment, takes minutes and is billed there
delete it afterwards in the console and list it under cleanup
steps: From the project of the previous case, say yes to PDS and ask for a database.
Follow the new_database workflow to the confirmation, confirm, and wait until the database is ready.
Ask the agent to connect the app and run a read query through the data server. Sign in with pds-mcp login --passwords if asked.
Delete the database in the console and note it in the report.
expect: The agent confirms before creating, waits for ready, gives connection details without the password, saves the password in the credential store and the query returns rows.

title: Confirmation before delete and before opening to the internet (elicitation, with the argument fallback)
costs: changes data: deletes a scratch database you created for this case
steps: In a client that supports elicitation, ask the agent to delete a scratch database. Decline the confirmation, then ask again and accept.
Ask the agent to create a public database open to 0.0.0.0/0. Decline, then accept.
In a client without elicitation, repeat both and read what the tool says.
Call delete_database with a wrong confirm value, and create_database with an open range and no acknowledgeOpenToInternet.
expect: A client with elicitation shows a confirmation and nothing changes on decline. A client without it is refused with the sentence that names the confirm or acknowledgeOpenToInternet argument, and the call goes through only with it.

title: Chat streams with both providers
steps: In the console Chat, pick the Anthropic model and ask a question that needs two or three reads.
Repeat with the Cursor provider.
Watch the step labels and the text while the turn runs.
expect: Step labels such as Reading metrics appear, the text arrives in pieces, and the first visible sign comes within a few seconds.

title: Chat delete with the right name
costs: changes data: deletes a scratch database you created for this case
steps: In the Chat, ask to delete a scratch database.
On the card, type a wrong name and confirm, then the right name and confirm.
expect: The wrong name keeps the card open with an error. The right name deletes the database, and Activity shows delete_database with client chat.

title: Scale, backup and schedule approved in the Chat show in Activity
costs: changes data: scales, backs up and reschedules a scratch database
steps: In the Chat, ask for a scale, a backup and a backup schedule, one after the other, and approve each card.
Open Activity.
expect: Each change is listed with client chat and the provider as the agent (Anthropic or Cursor).

title: Cards show no credentials, reply buttons only navigate, a reload cancels a pending card
steps: Ask the Chat for a change and read the card before answering.
Reload the page while the card is pending.
Click each button an answer offers.
expect: No password, token or connection string with a password on the card. After the reload the change did not happen and the thread says so. Buttons open a page and change nothing.

title: A pending card expires after 15 minutes (long)
steps: Ask the Chat for a change and leave the card unanswered for 15 minutes.
Then press Approve.
expect: The turn ends with the sentence that nothing changed, the card shows expired, and Approve answers that the approval is gone.

title: Organization limit applies at read and at change, in the Chat and in /mcp
steps: As an admin, set what agents may do to read. In the Chat and in an MCP client ask for a scale.
Set it to change and ask for a delete.
Put the setting back.
expect: At read no change tool is offered and the agent says it cannot change anything. At change the delete is refused as not allowed, and a scale shows a card.
